entity: Landmark Society of the Niagara Frontier
stance_basis: compiled list of historic structures along alignment; no adverse impact found
summary: The Landmark Society of the Niagara Frontier, represented by Mr. Olaf Shelgren, Jr., collaborated with the Buffalo Historical Society to compile a list of historic structures along the proposed rail alignment. The Society identified six sites it considered eligible for the National Register of Historic Places. No adverse impacts on any of the listed structures were anticipated from construction or operation of the transit system.
complaint_summary: The Landmark Society of the Niagara Frontier compiled a list of historic structures along the proposed rail alignment and identified six sites as meeting criteria for inclusion in the National Register of Historic Places, but raised no objections to the project.
summary_quote: The Buffalo Historical Society (under the direction of Dr. Walter S. Dunn, Jr.) and the Landmark Society of the Niagara Frontier (represented by Mr. Olaf Shelgren, Jr., Chairman) compiled a list of historic structures located along the proposed rail alignment.
